faq.question: What file types can I convert?
faq.answer: You can convert .xlsx, .xls, and .csv files. Whether you convert xls to json or xlsx to json, the same parser reads all three formats, so a CSV export behaves like a single-sheet spreadsheet.

faq.question: How are rows turned into JSON?
faq.answer: The first row of the selected sheet is treated as column headers and used as object keys. Each subsequent row becomes one JSON object. The final result is a JSON array of those objects.

faq.question: What if my workbook has multiple sheets?
faq.answer: A sheet selector appears when more than one sheet is present. Choose the sheet you want; only the selected sheet is converted.

faq.question: Are numbers and dates preserved?
faq.answer: Numeric cells are kept as JSON numbers and text cells as strings. Boolean cells such as TRUE/FALSE become JSON true/false. Spreadsheet date serials may be returned as numbers rather than formatted dates, because the converter reads raw cell values.

faq.question: How are empty cells handled?
faq.answer: Empty cells are returned as empty strings so that every object has the same set of keys. If you need null instead, post-process the output.

faq.question: Can I convert a large Excel file?
faq.answer: The practical limit depends on browser memory and the size of the file. Very large sheets may slow the page or the download. For huge exports, a local command-line tool such as a Python or Node script can be more reliable.

faq.question: Is my file data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. The file is read and parsed in your browser. It is not uploaded to a server and no account is required. Avoid files that contain passwords, tokens, or other sensitive production data.

faq.question: Is this a free Excel to JSON converter?
faq.answer: Yes. You can convert an Excel or CSV file, review the JSON, copy it, or download it without creating an account.

article.title: How to Convert Excel to JSON Online
article.content:
What Is Excel to JSON Conversion?

Excel to JSON conversion, also called spreadsheet to JSON conversion, reads a table and produces a JSON array where each row becomes an object. An Excel JSON result is a portable format for moving tabular data from Excel or CSV into a web API, a configuration file, or a data pipeline.

How the Conversion Works

  1. Open the file: choose an .xlsx, .xls, or .csv file. The file is read in your browser.
  2. Use the first row as keys: the header row becomes the object keys.
  3. Map each row: every following row becomes one JSON object.
  4. Collect the rows: all objects are returned as a JSON array.

Cell Types

Numeric cells stay numbers, text cells stay strings, and boolean cells such as TRUE/FALSE become JSON true/false. Empty cells are returned as empty strings so that every object keeps the same keys. Raw date serials may appear as numbers because the converter reads the underlying cell value.

Multiple Sheets

When a workbook has more than one sheet, select the sheet you want to convert. Only the selected sheet is turned into JSON.

When to Use It

  • API payloads: turn a spreadsheet export into request bodies.
  • Configuration: move tabular settings into JSON config.
  • Data pipelines: feed cleaned rows into scripts.
  • Prototyping: quickly get sample JSON from a table.

Privacy

Conversion runs entirely in your browser. Your file is not uploaded and no account is required. Do not open files that contain passwords, tokens, or production credentials in any online tool.

article.title: 如何在线把 Excel 转为 JSON
article.content:
什么是 Excel 转 JSON？

转换 excel 为 json（也叫表格转 json）是指读取一张电子表格，并生成一个 JSON 数组，其中每一行变成一个对象。Excel JSON 转换常用于把表格数据从 Excel 或 CSV 搬进 Web API、配置文件或数据管道。

转换是怎么进行的

  1. 打开文件：选择 .xlsx、.xls 或 .csv 文件，文件在你的浏览器中读取。
  2. 用第一行作为键：标题行变成对象的键。
  3. 映射每一行：其后的每一行变成一个 JSON 对象。
  4. 收集所有行：所有对象以 JSON 数组的形式返回。

单元格类型

数字单元格保持为数字，文本单元格保持为字符串，TRUE/FALSE 这类布尔单元格会变成 JSON 的 true/false。空单元格返回为空字符串，使每个对象都保留相同的键。原始的日期序列号可能以数字形式出现，因为转换器读取的是单元格底层的值。

多个工作表

当工作簿有多个工作表时，选择你要转换的那一个，只有所选工作表会被转成 JSON。

什么时候用它

  • API 请求体：把表格导出变成请求数据。
  • 配置：把表格设置搬进 JSON 配置。
  • 数据管道：把清洗后的行喂给脚本。
  • 原型：从一张表快速得到示例 JSON。

隐私

转换完全在你的浏览器中运行，文件不会被上传，也不需要账号。请勿在任何在线工具中打开含有密码、令牌或生产环境凭据的文件。
